PAHs (ANT/NAP/PYR) spiked into mineral particles and 6 soil samples at known initial concentrations (1 umol/g or 5 mg/kg) then irradiated under controlled UV/Xe lamp. Tables 1-2 contain kinetic rate constants (k_obs) and 9-NA formation rates (nu), not field pollutant concentrations. Six real soils (Jiangxi/Hainan/Chongqing/Heilongjiang/Jiangsu/Xinjiang) used only as substrates for lab irradiation; no baseline OP concentrations reported. 9-NA values in Section 3.9 (0.06-0.17 g/kg) are lab-formed nitration products from spiked ANT, not environmental contamination.
